note: One disease term (inflammation) is omitted; only six of the seven listed plagues are rendered.
'their root is in Amalek' changed to 'their root came from Amalek' (adds 'came', changes 'in' to 'from')
Omits 'in that year' (בַּשָּׁנָה הַהִיא), a distinct temporal detail present in the source.
Adds 'God' as agent of being raised ('الذي رفعه الله'), not in source's 'raised on high'.
Renders singular 'your servant' as plural 'your servants' (عبيدك).
Hebrew 'because you afflict them' rendered as 'so you answer them' — a different idea.
Omits 'and he spoke to him' (אָמַר לוֹ) between giving bread and giving land.
Subject of saddling reversed: Arabic says the brought-back prophet saddled the donkey, not the host saddling it for him.
Bread and water 'of affliction' (לַחַץ) rendered as 'with little'; the idea of affliction/oppression is replaced.
Omits 'a great army' and says 'his place' became like the place of God's army.
Omits 'one/single' (חֲדָה) modifying the scroll; Arabic has only 'a scroll'.
Omits 'registered by genealogy' (הִתְיַחֵשׂ), reducing it to 'of the males'.
Source is first person 'I said' (Nehemiah), Arabic has 'he said' (وَقَالَ), changing the speaker.
Changes 'your fear is your confidence' to 'your reliance is on your fear' and links hope to integrity of ways.
Turns 'I am blameless' into a conditional 'if I were perfect'.
Changes the statement 'to dust you will return me' into a question.
Renders 'host with me' as 'host against me' and adds 'circumstances change'.
"he would put [strength] in me" rendered as "he listens to me" — different idea.
"until the end of light with darkness" changed to "a boundary between light and darkness" — idea altered.
Adds 'forsaken' and 'their place was' not in the source; the wilderness-desolation image is recast.
'it does not profit me' changed to 'he did not repay me for that' — different subject and idea
Source 'in their place' (תחתם) rendered as 'from their places', changing the sense.
Arabic says 'I kept the paths of the violent' (missing 'from'), reversing the sense; also 'from the works of man' instead of 'according to'.
Past 'you answered me' changed to imperative 'answer me' (استجب لي), altering the statement.
Replaces 'like the living, like the fierce wrath' with 'whether green or burnt'; changes subject 'he' to 'the storm'.
Changes 'Who will see them?' to 'Who sees us?' — person/referent altered.
Omission of 'wide' (make wide) in 'open your mouth wide'.
Renders 'of old' as 'before the appearance of the face of the earth', adding an idea not in the source.
The temporal/logical 'then' (אֲזַי) is omitted.
Adds 'in peace' (بسلام) and 'so that' not in source; 'together' attached to the wicked rather than 'I'.
'Days of old' (מִקֶּדֶם) rendered 'days from the east' (من الشرق), adding a wrong idea and losing 'of old'.
Renders 'withholds from uprightness' as 'withholds more than is proper', adding a comparative idea not in source.
Adds a clause not in source: 'and their mouth overflows with it' (وفمهم يفيض بها).
Adds the clause 'as if it were a jewel,' a simile not present in the source.
Arabic says God tests them to show them, omitting that they may see; changes subject of seeing.
Second 'your loves' is rendered 'your breasts'; adds breasts and omits the repeated loves.
'Towers of perfume' is rendered as 'buds/sleeves of perfume'; the 'towers' image is omitted.
Omits the clause 'he fenced/digged it' (ויעזקהו); only stone-clearing and planting are rendered.
Adds comparison 'their images were more than those of Jerusalem and Samaria', changing 'from Jerusalem and Samaria' into a comparison.
'Palaces' (ארמנותיה) is omitted; 'towers' is repeated instead, adding an idea not in the source.
Arabic negates the cart wheel's action ('wheel and horses do not crush'), losing the positive clause about the wheel.
Reverses clause: says 'no one calls to a king' instead of 'they shall call to the kingdom, but none shall be there'.
Omits 'to them' (לָמוֹ) as recipients of the declared signs.
Renders 'you were able' as 'you did them well', adding an idea not in the source.
Subject of striking and casting changed from the king (singular 'he') to 'they' (plural).
Changed 'going to give him rest' (God giving rest) into 'Israel going to his rest'—agent of resting altered.
Source 'in order to cut you off' (God's action) rendered as 'you destroy yourselves,' changing the agent.
Hebrew 'scorned hire' is reversed to 'seeks the wage' (التي تطلب الأجرة)
Adds 'بالنار' (through fire), not present in the source's 'causing every firstling of the womb to pass'.
Adds 'your hand' and 'at the fork/crossroads' (عند المفترق), not in the source.
Arabic omits the modifier 'your swimming/overflowing' attached to the land in the source.
Arabic uses plural 'يُطرَدون' (they are driven out) instead of singular 'you shall be driven'; also 'تتغير' for 'pass over'
Omits 'the king answered' — the speaker of 'said' is left unidentified
Omitted 'forest' (יָעַר); 'high places of forest' rendered as 'rugged heights'.
Source 'your wrath' becomes 'his wrath'; 'their nakedness' made singular 'his'; adds 'upon him'.
Omits 'yet once more' (עוד אחת); only 'after a little' is rendered.
Pronoun changed from masculine 'his' to feminine 'her' (دمها/فمها), altering the referent.
Adds 'it was said' (قيل), a speech introduction not in the source.
Adds 'they pressed him from every side,' not in source; 'without rest' reverses 'with ease/Menuchah'.
Omitted 'the entrance of the temple' (ופתח הבית); only the inner doors are mentioned.
Last phrase renders 'enemies' as singular 'his enemy' and does not express 'keeps wrath for'.
Reverses speaker: Hebrew 'when I called, they did not hear'; Arabic 'as they called, they did not hear'.
Adds 'repaired' (أصلح), a predicate not in the source verse.
Renders 'slander' as 'put a stumbling block' (تضع معثرة), changing the idea.
Renders 'are snared' as 'are made to fall' (يوقع), omitting the snare idea.
Renders passive 'brought low' as reflexive 'humble themselves' (يتواضعون), adding self-humbling.
